name: Hemorrhage
overview: Scripture addresses the condition of hemorrhage primarily through the example of a woman who suffered from an issue of blood for twelve years, as described in Matthew 9:20 and Mark 5:25-28. This woman endured great physical suffering and sought healing from many physicians without success, but her faith led her to touch the hem of Jesus' garment, believing she would be made whole. Additionally, Leviticus 15:19 outlines the ceremonial implications of a woman’s menstrual bleeding, indicating a period of separation due to uncleanness. Together, these passages highlight both the physical and spiritual dimensions of hemorrhage, showing God's provision for healing and the importance of faith in Christ.
